checks.detail: T7 TaskSpec envelope binds allowed_files (six t7 evidence files, run_research.py, run_research_cycle.py, autonomous_runner.py, automation_controller.py, campaign_preflight.py, and the three owned test modules), forbids every other campaign/control-plane module, data/KBase, scheduler/ACL, user files, strategy, requirements, and non-owned tests; payload_sha256 matches canonical serialization.

All sixteen input evidence references hash-match the live repository: P6 approval, scope manifest, implementation baseline, T1 task report/validation/completion, and T2 through T6 task reports and completions; baseline_sha256 matches implementation_baseline.json.

The only tracked source changes are the five owned modules (run_research.py, run_research_cycle.py, autonomous_runner.py, automation_controller.py, campaign_preflight.py) and their three owned test modules; data, KBase, strategy, policy, scheduler/ACL, user files, and all other control-plane modules are untouched.

campaign_preflight.py exposes CampaignBoundaryError and require_campaign_boundary; a surface without a formal Campaign execution context is rejected with LEGACY_SURFACE_WITHOUT_CAMPAIGN_CONTEXT, formal inputs are evaluated by run_campaign_preflight, and any non-WOULD_ACCEPT verdict raises with its rejection codes.

Every non-read-only run_research command (brainstorm, discover, resume-discover, execute-handoff, full-cycle, repair-handoff-runner, review, chat, roundtable, interactive) routes through _campaign_boundary before orchestrator/config/repair construction; execute-handoff --dry-run remains the sole read-only exemption; main maps CampaignBoundaryError to exit code 3 before any side effect.

AutomationController._authorize_controller and AutonomousRunnerV1.run both consult the fail-closed Campaign boundary before any output directory, runner construction, or experiment write can occur; run_research_cycle.py routes through the same gate and returns 3.

p7_authorized=false, campaign_authorized=false, final_holdout_authorized=false, auto_advance=false; no real data/KBase read or update, no scheduler/ACL mutation, no daily update/backtest/research/campaign/holdout started.

advisories.detail: execute-handoff --dry-run is read-only in the adopted CLI registry (dry_run_without_authority) and remains exempt from the Campaign boundary; all other dry-run flags (full-cycle, repair-handoff-runner) still cross the boundary because they can write outputs.

No legacy surface receives a formal Campaign execution context in this slice; T10/T12 will attach the fake-only dry-run boundary. Until then every legacy execution command, controller, and autonomous runner is intentionally rejected.
